materials:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game material atlas for Lockdown, painted fantasy arena.
Generate a single 1536 x 3072 pixel image, EXACTLY 3 equal columns and 6 equal rows (18 square 512 x 512 texture cells), edge-to-edge with NO gaps, NO borders, NO labels. These will be cut mechanically. All cells orthographic material textures, NOT miniature scenes. Same refined hand-painted 3D fantasy art direction throughout, broad quiet forms, warm upper-left light, subtle bevels, restrained details, no noisy grain. Seamless opposite edges for each cell.

Column 1 is overhead WALKABLE FLOOR material, column 2 is front-facing vertical MASONRY of same material, column 3 is a distant HAZARD/background texture with absolutely no shore or ledges.

Row 1 CASTLE: floor muted warm grey limestone pavers; wall same grey limestone ashlar; hazard deep blue still moat water.
Row 2 HEDGE MAZE: floor muted tan worn sandstone paving with tiny moss joints; wall dense sculpted emerald hedge leaves; hazard dark green bog water.
Row 3 FOUNDRY: floor muted dark bronze metal plates with restrained rivets; wall stacked dark iron and brass panels; hazard molten orange lava with large dark crust islands.
Row 4 SUNKEN TEMPLE: floor muted sandy ivory stone with tiny teal weathering; wall same ancient sandstone blocks; hazard quiet desaturated turquoise pool water.
Row 5 GRAVEYARD: floor muted blue-grey slate pavers with restrained moss; wall same darker blue slate ashlar; hazard near-black blue mist over a deep crevice.
Row 6 SKY BRIDGES: floor warm pale ivory limestone slabs with narrow aged brass joints; wall same pale limestone ashlar with slim aged brass horizontal inlays; hazard soft distant pale blue sky and faint wisps of clouds from directly above, low contrast, no horizon.

Floor slabs about one quarter cell width, all floor textures flat top-down with absolutely no perspective, no protruding objects, no shadows of objects. Wall cells are uninterrupted tiling surfaces without pillars, end caps, vines, frames or rails. No characters, weapons, buildings, letters, symbols, interface, black outlines, baked ambient occlusion or black empty areas. Visually cohesive material library.
props:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game sprite atlas for Lockdown.
Use the provided material atlas ONLY as style and palette reference. Create a NEW 1536x3072 atlas, EXACTLY 3 columns and 6 rows, each cell 512x512, no lines, no text, no labels. Transparent background, generous empty margin in EVERY cell, no cast shadows, no ground plane. Each row matches a material row of the reference.
Camera same orthographic three-quarter view for ALL upright objects, light upper left, painted rounded fantasy 3D, broad clean silhouettes, restrained weathering, same proportions.
Column 1: a single compact low masonry pillar, straight vertical, symmetrical, capped with a small warm lantern; the feet centered at bottom.
Column 2: low border clump of three small stones and restrained plants or pipes, wide and low.
Column 3: one small wall-hanging ivy cluster (or foundry pipe cluster), attachment across its top, dangling downward, no wall background.
Rows in order: 1 castle muted grey limestone with moss; 2 hedge maze tan sandstone pillar and emerald leaves; 3 foundry dark iron with aged brass trim, border pipes, hanging short copper pipes; 4 temple pale sand stone and teal weathering with small fern leaves; 5 graveyard dark blue slate and sparse muted ivy; 6 sky bridges warm ivory stone with narrow aged brass trim and very sparse small green leaves.
Keep every object fully INSIDE its cell, clean transparent padding all around. No character, no weapons, no UI. Match shapes and scale across rows. No black rectangular backgrounds or detached stray objects.
point: A production game asset on a completely TRANSPARENT background. Single isolated circular fantasy capture-point medallion, strict top-down orthographic view, perfectly circular with diameter 80% of square canvas. Flat inset ivory limestone ring, narrow worn brass rim, dark muted teal center, four small unlit ivory insets at cardinal points. Restrained hand-painted 3D fantasy materials and soft bevels, upper-left lighting. Low contrast, minimal ornament. Completely opaque inside disc, completely transparent outside disc. NO backdrop, no glow, no cast shadow, no text, no UI, no perspective, no beacon, no extra objects.
common:
Production sprite sheet on TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Six isolated objects in an exact 3-column 2-row grid. All six are painted 3D fantasy game objects, warm ivory stone, muted teal and antique brass, soft upper-left light, orthographic three-quarter view. 1536x1024. True alpha transparency everywhere outside the six object silhouettes. No backdrop, absolutely NO glows, NO haze, NO floor, NO shadows. Leave large transparent padding between objects.
Row 1 left: squat low ivory-and-brass pedestal holding one SMALL pale cyan crystal. Wider than tall.
Row 1 middle: squat ivory-and-brass pedestal holding one small opaque red heart.
Row 1 right: wide shallow ivory stone arch flanked by two small unlit lanterns, interior is solid closed masonry. Wider than tall.
Row 2 left: slim banner post with amber cloth and one white diamond.
Row 2 middle: matching slim banner post with teal cloth and one white diamond.
Row 2 right: small red rounded heart pickup alone.
All objects fully contained within their equal square cells and all complete, with no parts cut off. No lettering. Transparent alpha background, game-ready cutouts, no environment.
